name: Air Fryer Pork Chops with Apple Slaw and Potatoes

components.name: Honey Mustard Pork Chops

ingredients.name: Raw boneless pork loin chops, trimmed

steps: Coat raw pork with Dijon and honey mixture and refrigerate at least four hours or overnight.

Press marinated chops into the weighed panko and mist lightly with measured oil. Air fry in a single layer at 200 C, turning, for about 10-14 minutes or until 63 C plus a three-minute rest for whole pork chops.
Serve each cooked chop with potatoes and dressed apple slaw. Freeze pork and cooked potatoes only; store slaw fresh.

components.name: Air-Fried Potatoes
steps: Air fry halved potatoes separately with the measured oil until tender and browned, around 15-20 minutes depending on size.

components.name: Apple Slaw

ingredients.name: Raw apples, cored and thinly sliced

steps: Thinly slice cabbage and apple. Keep slaw vegetables, Greek yogurt, vinegar and dressing mustard chilled in separate containers until ready to eat.
